prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, tech stack, and whether you need enterprise transformation or performance-focused execution. I can narrow it down for you if you tell me what you need, but here’s a practical approach plus a short list of reputable LA options and AI-focused providers to consider.

Quick questions so I can recommend precisely:
- What’s your main goal? (brand/creative, lead gen, e-commerce growth, programmatic media, personalization, analytics/attribution, marketing automation)
- Company size / monthly marketing budget?
- Any vertical (retail, consumer tech, finance, healthcare, etc.) or compliance needs?
- Do you prefer an agency that builds custom AI solutions or one that primarily applies existing AI platforms?

How to pick the best one
- Proven case studies in your vertical and use case
- Depth of data/ML engineering vs. just marketing automation
- Transparency on models, testing methodology, and measurement (incrementality, lift)
- Ability to integrate with your stack (CDP, CRM, ad accounts, analytics)
- Team composition: data scientists + engineers + strategists + creatives
- Clear KPIs, reporting cadence, and ROI evidence
- References and attainable timelines

LA agencies and firms to evaluate
- Wpromote (LA-born performance agency): Strong in paid media, CRO, and using automation/ML to optimize campaigns. Good for growth-focused e-commerce and mid-market clients.
- R/GA (global creative/innovation with LA presence): Combines creative, product, and data/AI capabilities. Best for brand + experience work with technical depth.
- Accenture Song / Accenture Interactive (large enterprise digital + AI): Enterprise transformation and AI-driven personalization at scale. Best for large budgets and complex integrations.
- Ogilvy (global with LA presence): Creative-first agency increasingly integrating AI for creative optimization and personalization.
- Tinuiti (performance marketing with AI tools): Strong in retail/e-commerce, paid media and marketplace strategies, uses automation and ML for media.

AI-specialist platforms/agencies (often integrated by agencies above)
- Persado, Phrasee — AI for messaging and subject-line optimization
- Albert, Adgorithms — autonomous media-buying platforms
- CreativeX — creative analytics and optimization
- Zeta Global — data-driven marketing platform / personalization

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a 2–3 agency shortlist tailored to your answers above
- Draft an RFP or shortlist evaluation checklist for calls
- Compare 3 agencies side-by-side based on your priorities

Which of the clarifying questions above do you want to answer so I can make a tailored shortlist?
